name: Lard Lost His Lunch
summary: Lard, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, is hungry and frightened. A Vilebranch struck Lard during a private picnic, and Lard fled without lunch. You are asked to fetch it from an island to the north.

sections.title: A Picnic Interrupted
sections.body: Lard was picnicking at a secret spot when a Vilebranch, ugly and mean in Lard's telling, hit Lard with a big stick. Lard bolted for Revantusk and left the lunch behind. Now Lard is hungry, and afraid to go back.

sections.title: The Island Northward
sections.body: The picnic spot lies on an island to the north. Lard hopes you will go there, find the lunch and bring it back, taking care around the Vilebranch trolls.

sections.title: Lard's Thanks
sections.body: The lunch turns out to be a huge haunch of meat. Lard wolfs it down, thanks you, and promises you a special picnic basket for your help.

faq.answer: A resident of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, hungry and frightened after a Vilebranch struck Lard with a big stick.

faq.q: Where did Lard lose his lunch?
faq.answer: At a hidden picnic spot on an island to the north.

faq.q: Why did Lard leave his food behind?
faq.answer: A Vilebranch hit Lard with a big stick during the picnic, and Lard ran back to Revantusk without the lunch.

faq.q: What should you watch out for on the island?
faq.answer: Lard names the Vilebranch trolls as the danger on the island.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lard Lost His Lunch
